info.title: Save you a Seat API
info.description: Contract for the future Python API. The first release is an explicitly labelled browser-local demo. Identity always comes from verified Cognito access tokens. Separate staff login does not grant a role. Confirmations count verified accounts, not proven unique humans. Public facility details return only the active published guide, with temporary image URLs. Guides include internal confirmation IDs for signed-in review; public responses must redact user identifiers. All published content is sample data until an operator supplies verified listings.

CognitoAccessToken.description: Access token only, with API Gateway configured issuer/client ID/scope. Staff additionally requires verified staff group in Python.

countryCode.description: Country of the catalog facility; the map viewport is not a country geofence.

area.description: Supported catalog area for this release.

Facility.description: A catalog facility in the supported Australian Cremorne area. Current local fixtures are fictional demo venues; official external booking providers are maintained separately and do not imply availability for these facilities.

GuideInput.description: Draft input may be incomplete. Submission requires a nonblank title and 1-5 finalized image steps with nonblank captions; server derives identity and frozen confirmation state.

UploadTicket.description: Multipart S3 presigned POST; append signed fields and then the file. Server policy restricts key, type, and content length.

guide.description: The active public guide, or null when no guide is published.

PublicGuide.description: Guest-visible publication. Does not expose account IDs, draft images, or moderation records.

CatalogCoordinates.description: Coordinates inside the supported Cremorne catalog rectangle.

SupportedOriginCoordinates.description: A coordinate inside the supported local Melbourne focus window, enclosing Cremorne and UniMelb. This product coverage rectangle is not an Australian country boundary.
